summary.description: Two to five sentences: what the PR does and your overall assessment.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file in the PR head.

line.description: Line number in the PR head version of the file (last line of the range).

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range, or null for a single line.

body.description: Concrete failure scenario (inputs/state -> wrong result) and the fix you recommend.

suggestion.description: Exact replacement text for lines start_line..line, or null. Only when certain.
